summary: The diff implements Reflect.setPrototypeOf in the stub, following the three spec steps. Step 1 throws a TypeError when target is not an Object. Step 2 throws a TypeError unless proto is an Object or null. Step 3 propagates the result of target.internal_set_prototype_of(agent, proto) with `?` and returns it as a Boolean. The step comments are kept in place. The only other edit is renaming the unused `this` and `new_target` parameters to `_this` and `_new_target`, which is needed to avoid unused-variable warnings. The two remaining test262 failures come from the engine's own Proxy [[SetPrototypeOf]] not-implemented error, which is an honest throw and not a defect in this file. No special-casing, made-up values, swallowed errors or skipped steps were found.
